attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Single Cell Multi-Omics of Human Preimplantation Embryos Demonstrates Susceptibility to Excess Glucocorticoid Exposure

attributes.name: Study type
attributes.value: RNA-seq of coding RNA from single cells

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: We then utilized parallel single-cell RNA sequencing and bisulfite sequencing to explore the impact of GC exposure on the human embryo.  In addition, to further explore the role of epigenetic regulation as a mechanism for the observed transcriptional changes, we examined the effects of GCs on small non-coding RNA using smallseq.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Embryos were acquired fresh (not vitrified) from preimplantation genetic diagnosis (PGD) testing on embryonic day (E) 4 and were cultured until E7 (expanded blastocyst, just prior to implantation) under standard conditions as performed in the IVF Clinic (5% CO2/5% O2 in IVF plates containing 700μl of CCMTM media (Vitrolife) covered with 300μl of OvoilTM (Vitrolife).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Indexed sequence libraries per molecular target were pooled for multiplexing and single-end sequencing was performed on HiSeq 2000 using TrueSeq dual-index sequencing primers (Illumina)

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Embryos were acquired fresh (not vitrified) from preimplantation genetic diagnosis (PGD) testing on embryonic day (E) 4 and were cultured until E7 (expanded blastocyst in media supplemented with glucocorticoid (dexamethasone, 0.1µg/ml (2.5µM)).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Human embryos were obtained the Huddinge Karolinska Hospital with ethical approval from regional ethics board (2018/691-31).  Embryos were dissociated through trituration in TrypLE, (Life technologies) and handpicked with fine glass capillaries.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Cells were directly dispensed in lysis buffer prepared according to a modified version of the snMT-seq protocol.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: the cDNA libraries were generated using Smart-seq2 as previously described.The quantity and quality of the cDNA, small ncRNA and DNA methylation libraries were assessed using an Agilent 2100 BioAnalyzer (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: For single-cell RNA-Seq data, reads quality was firstly checked by FastQC. High-quality reads were mapped to the human reference genome (build hg38) using STAR with default settings, and only uniquely mapped reads were kept for gene expression quantification. Raw read counts and RPKM (reads per kilobase of transcripts, per million mapped reads) were estimated using rpkmforgenes with the option of “-readcount -fulltranscript -mRNAnorm -rmnameoverlap -bothendsceil” on transcripts derived from RefSeq annotaton

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: We used library size excluding mitochondrial genes for computation of the transcriptome TPM (transcripts per million mapped reads).
